title: Firmus nearly doubles valuation to over $10.5 billion in 4 months with Nvidia-backed fundraise
title_zh: 通过 Nvidia 支持的融资，Firmus 的估值在 4 个月内几乎翻了一番，达到 105 亿美元以上
summary: Firmus said on Friday it had raised $2 billion in equity in its ‌latest funding round to speed up the ‌build-out of AI factories in Australia and Asia Pacific, bringing up ​the company's post-money valuation to above $10.5 billion.
summary_zh: Firmus 周五表示，它已在最新一轮融资中筹集了 20 亿美元的股权，以加快澳大利亚和亚太地区人工智能工厂的建设，使该公司的投后估值达到 105 亿美元以上。

title: Meta ordered to pay $567 million in New Mexico for teen mental health fund
title_zh: Meta被责令为新墨西哥州青少年心理健康基金支付5.67亿美元
summary: Aug 6 (Reuters) - A New Mexico state court ordered Meta on Thursday to pay $567 million into a teen mental health fund and change how its platforms function for young users after finding the company is to blame for harming children's wellbeing.
summary_zh: 路透 8 月 6 日 - 新墨西哥州法院发现 Meta 应对损害儿童福祉负有责任，周四下令 Meta 向青少年心理健康基金支付 5.67 亿美元，并改变其平台针对年轻用户的运作方式。

title: Exclusive-Alibaba plans to charge big users of its next open-source AI model, sources say
title_zh: 消息人士称，阿里巴巴计划向大用户收取其下一代开源人工智能模型的费用
summary: By Stephen Nellis and Eduardo Baptista Aug 7 (Reuters) - Chinese technology giant Alibaba plans to ask major users of the next version of its Qwen open-source AI model for a share of revenue they make
summary_zh: 作者：Stephen Nellis 和 Eduardo Baptista，8 月 7 日（路透社）——中国科技巨头阿里巴巴计划向其下一版本 Qwen 开源人工智能模型的主要用户询问其收入分成

title: Stocks slip as investors eye Mideast talks, earnings
title_zh: 投资者关注中东谈判和财报，股市下跌
summary: STORY: Stocks fell Thursday, pausing after a strong start to the week.The Dow dropped close to one percent.
summary_zh: 故事：周四股市下跌，在本周开局强劲后暂停。道琼斯指数下跌近百分之一。

title: Why Rivian's R2 EV could be its new star vehicle
title_zh: 为什么 Rivian 的 R2 EV 可能成为其新的明星车型
summary: Yahoo Finance Senior Autos Reporter Pras Subramanian explains what you need to know about Rivian's (RIVN) R2 electric vehicle (EV).
summary_zh: 雅虎财经高级汽车记者 Pras Subramanian 解释了您需要了解的有关 Rivian (RIVN) R2 电动汽车 (EV) 的信息。

title: Furniture retailers gain on high-income consumer spending: AlphaSpace
title_zh: 家具零售商受益于高收入消费者支出：AlphaSpace
summary: Using Yahoo Finance's AlphaSpace platform, Senior Reporter Brooke DiPalma takes a closer look at how furniture retail stocks are faring as more consumers open up their wallets to spend on higher-end furniture.
summary_zh: 高级记者布鲁克·迪帕尔玛 (Brooke DiPalma) 利用雅虎财经的 AlphaSpace 平台，仔细研究了随着越来越多的消费者掏腰包购买高端家具，家具零售股的表现如何。

title: Microsoft is starting to show its payoff on major AI plays
title_zh: 微软开始在主要人工智能领域展示其回报
summary: Investors may have renewed confidence in Microsoft's (MSFT) AI strategy on the tech giant's reported growth in its Azure Cloud and Copilot businesses. Yahoo Finance Tech Editor Dan Howley dives into the details.
summary_zh: 由于微软 Azure 云和 Copilot 业务的增长，投资者可能对微软 (MSFT) 的人工智能战略重新充满信心。雅虎财经技术编辑 Dan Howley 深入探讨了细节。

title: Alphabet's $25B debt sale underscores hyperscalers' AI arms race
title_zh: Alphabet 的 250 亿美元债务出售凸显了超大规模企业的人工智能军备竞赛
summary: Yahoo Finance Markets and Data Editor Jared Blikre joins Market Domination to discuss Alphabet (GOOGL, GOOG) following the tech giant's $25 billion debt raise, the latest move in the hyperscalers' AI infrastructure spending race.
summary_zh: 雅虎金融市场和数据编辑 Jared Blikre 与 Market Domination 一起讨论 Alphabet（GOOGL、GOOG），此前这家科技巨头筹集了 250 亿美元的债务，这是超大规模企业人工智能基础设施支出竞赛的最新举措。

title: What the bond market is signaling for SpaceX's hopes to ramp up debt sales
title_zh: 债券市场对 SpaceX 增加债务销售的希望发出了什么信号
summary: Wellington Management fixed income portfolio manager Brij Khurana weighs in on what the bond market (^TYX, ^TNX, ^FVX) could be signaling about SpaceX's (SPCX) debt sales plans, especially as shares of Elon Musk's space venture continue to slide lower.
summary_zh: Wellington Management 固定收益投资组合经理 Brij Khurana 对债券市场（^TYX、^TNX、^FVX）可能对 SpaceX (SPCX) 债务出售计划发出的信号进行了权衡，特别是在埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的太空企业股价继续下滑的...
